text:
jordan: Heads up — nightly eval for 'billing-clarify' jumped from 2% -> 18% failures overnight. Spike aligns with sampling defaults change? :eyes:
eval-bot: nightly-eval-results | model: rwd-xlarge-v2 | failure_rate: 0.18 | temp: 0.8 | top_p: 0.95 | seed: random
maria: which commit rolled last night?
jordan: deploy 2025-09-27T03:12 (commit 2f4a7) — changed default sampling to temp=0.8 in inference-config.
kevin: can you paste the eval job config?
jordan: ```json
{"model":"rwd-xlarge-v2","sampling":{"temp":0.8,"top_p":0.95,"top_k":40,"seed":null},"batch_size":8}
```
sam: interesting — failures are hallucinations, not timeouts. do we see same at temp=0.6?
jordan: quick local run: temp=0.6 -> 3% failures; temp=0.8 -> 17%. top_k/top_p unchanged.
luis: could be seed handling: I saw harness not reseeding between prompts in last-nightly run (see ticket INFR-2027).
maria: @kevin can you run a controlled bisect across temp [0.5,0.6,0.7,0.8] and compare fixed-seed vs null-seed? target 1k samples per cell.
kevin: starting now — will launch jobs with seed=42 (fixed) and seed=null (system).
eval-bot: job queued: eval/1754829101-temp-bisect (https://redwood.internal/evals/1754829101)
sam: also include top_k=0 vs 40 and top_p 0.9 vs 0.95 in the grid.
jordan: add token-level outputs + logprobs (`--emit-logprobs`) so we can inspect distribution shifts.
kevin: uploaded first batch results. preliminary: fixed-seed reduces variance but failure rate still jumps at temp >= 0.7.
maria: if fixed-seed still shows the jump, that implies sampling params change model output distribution deterministically, not a seed-leak bug.
jordan: suggested mitigation: 1) reproduce a single-prompt deterministic run to show diff 2) verify harness reseed logic 3) temporarily roll nightly default temp back to 0.6 until root cause found.
sam: +1 rollback and put a feature-flag to pin sampling in nightly.
luis: logging request: emit effective_sampling_state (temp/top_p/top_k/seed) per-sample in eval trace for easier debugging.
kevin: opening PR to add reseed + per-sample sampling metadata and linking PR to INFR-2027.
maria: thanks — please paste artifacts (example bad gens, diffs, job links) back into this thread. :thumbsup:
jordan: will post example bad generations and the bisect artifacts here when available.
